description: Forge documents into traceable Obsidian Vault packages or structured knowledge JSON for MCP servers.

defaultPrompt: Guide me step by step to forge a complete project into resumable Obsidian Vault ZIP volumes. / 一步一步引導我把完整專案鍛造成可續作的 Obsidian Vault ZIP 分卷。
Continue my project forge from FORGE-CHECKPOINT.md and process only the next source batch. / 從 FORGE-CHECKPOINT.md 繼續，只處理下一批來源。
Build MCP knowledge-base JSON from my documents. / 將我的文件鍛造成 MCP 知識庫 JSON。
interface.longDescription: EW Knowledge Forge preserves Obsidian project forging and checkpoint continuation, and adds document-to-JSON knowledge forging for MCP servers as the third entry. PDF, Word, Markdown, text and other supported sources become structured records with separate summaries, full text, source locations, relations, legal extensions and governance metadata. Bundled validation and packaging prepare files for server integration; they do not deploy or connect a server. Enterprise classification and approval apply to either output path. / EW 知識鍛造保留 Obsidian 專案鍛造與檢查點續作，第三個入口新增 MCPserver 知識鍛造。支援將 PDF、Word、Markdown、文字等可讀取來源鍛造成結構化 JSON，分開保存摘要、全文、來源位置、關聯、法規擴充與治理資訊，並附驗證及打包程式。產出供後端整合的文件，不代表已部署或連接 MCPserver。企業分級與核准仍適用於兩種輸出。

name: ew-obsidian-knowledge-forge
